mermaid_github_compatibility.note: GitHub has strict Mermaid diagram requirements that differ from other renderers
rules: NEVER use inline styling in sequence diagrams (style statements cause parse errors)
Remove all 'style X fill:#color' statements from sequenceDiagram blocks
Styling is only supported in flowcharts and some other diagram types
Always test Mermaid syntax against GitHub's renderer limitations
Focus on structure and clarity over visual styling for sequence diagrams
Avoid special characters in node text: quotes, apostrophes, colons, @ symbols
Remove quotes from JSON examples in diagram nodes
Email addresses with @ symbols are treated as markdown links - use descriptive text instead
Simplify complex text content that might contain reserved characters
common_errors: Parse error: got 'TXT' - usually caused by style statements in sequence diagrams
Expecting arrow types but got 'TXT' - mixing style with sequence elements
Unsupported markdown: link - caused by @ symbols in email addresses or URLs
JSON-like content with quotes and colons breaks GitHub Mermaid parser
Email addresses like user@example.com are interpreted as markdown links
best_practices: Use participant aliases for cleaner sequence diagrams
Keep flowchart styling simple and GitHub-compatible
Test all diagrams in GitHub preview before committing
Prioritize GitHub compatibility over rich styling
